## AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.

HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval. Every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also: resume builder and mock interviews. Free plan with 10 auto-applies.

Review HireQuotient?

Reviewers say HireQuotient makes hiring faster and easier by bringing sourcing, screening, outreach, and interviewing into one simple workflow. Users repeatedly praise the clean, user-friendly interface, especially the ability to find candidates and contact them through email and LinkedIn without switching tools. One reviewer also reports a shorter hiring cycle, better early retention, and less screening burden after using custom tests and the virtual interviewer. The main limitation mentioned is coverage: some users want access to candidates and roles beyond sales and marketing, including finance and banking.
